inspector_summary:
4 parts selected — reference Industrial Workbench (stays put; shown below).
Also selected: Destination Bin, Reject Bin, Spare Bin
Arrange them with the toolbar above the 3D view. Ctrl+click adds or removes parts.
mate_missed_click: That click missed every part, so nothing changed. Still picked: Destination Bin · Rim plane (normal points up) on Industrial Workbench · surface · plane (points up). Apply, or Replace one.

multi_delete.tooltip: Delete removes one part at a time; 4 parts are selected.

steps: load fixture cell
wait for the Product View
baseline
native: select the workbench from the hierarchy
plain 3D click selects the workbench (reference)
Ctrl+click in 3D adds the destination bin
Ctrl+click in the hierarchy adds the reject and spare bins
selection shown everywhere
selection shown in the hierarchy, Inspector and chip
toolbar availability explains itself
Delete with four parts selected is refused, not applied to the reference
Viewer keyboard nudge with four parts selected moves nothing
Align front: preview ghosts, then Cancel
Align front: Apply is one exact transaction
Undo and Redo the whole alignment in one step, keeping the selection
Checks reports the generated handoff and validation as Stale after an edit
Align left with ΔX +30 mm and Keep relative mounts every member exactly
Distribute along X with an exact 60 mm gap
Applied arrangement shown
Save Layout
close and reopen
wait for the reopened Product View
reopened placements are identical
Fixed mount is atomic and the bins follow the workbench
narrow view: tools stay reachable through the overflow menu
Mate: rim and surface chosen, then a missed click keeps both picks
Switching cells with unsaved edits asks first; Stay keeps everything
Discard opens AirPick with a clean session (no undo, no selection, not dirty)
AirPick: read-only preview, Save disabled everywhere
AirPick settled: viewer shows AirPick, Save still disabled, no leaked viewer edits
switch_dialog_Discard edits and open: ur5_2f_test has unsaved layout edits. Opening another cell discards them; Undo cannot bring them back.
switch_dialog_Stay: ur5_2f_test has unsaved layout edits. Opening another cell discards them; Undo cannot bring them back.
